svg.title: AREA 45
svg.desc: Go south for both switches to open the pink gate; this triggers lightning traps in the previous dark room. The yellow bulb marks another light switch. Dashed white: equipment shortcut. Both sets of pads need 8 weapons and 8 shields in total and trigger fire traps. Follow yellow if spare equipment is insufficient. Do not shoot the wall or overhead light-off switches. Break the rocks and use both orange switches to continue. In the far-right switch room, use only the near switch by the entrance, not the one at the far end. Use both purple switches and warp 1→1′, then head west to the boss. The healing point and final-room boxes are optional. Both switches trigger lightning traps in the previous dark room. Shortcut: both sets total 8 weapons + 8 shields. Otherwise take the normal route. Do not shoot either wall switch: they turn lights off. Do not shoot the overhead switch. Use only the near switch by the entrance. North boxes: no traps. South boxes: no traps. Optional healing for the Force. Light switch here. Send one player left for the lights. Break the rocks to proceed.

g.title: PSO Palace: both switches trigger Gizonde Popup Traps in the previous room (Area 45)
Sakura: four weapons/shields per gate; PSO World: combined total (Area 45)
